formalRules.summary: The §4.4 contractions may be used as standalone forms.
The §4.4 contractions may be extended by word particles, including prefixes and suffixes.
The §4.4 contractions may be combined with other words.
Application restrictions for the §4.4 contraction inventory are governed by Chapter 4.9.
sourceWitnesses: Einschränkungen bei der Anwendung dieser Kürzungen siehe Kap. 4.9

crossPhaseDependencyResolution.reason: Section 4.4 explicitly allows its listed Zweiformige Kürzungen to stand alone; therefore the source term 'zweiformige Lautgruppenkürzungen' must remain taxonomically distinct until separately resolved.
